instructions.core_directive:
Use case: Technology debt by owner group.

Use the `ask` intent tool with this question in plain language against the seeded CMDB and TRM data (records labelled `[orch-test]`). Use `find` first when you need the class or source names. Do not query ServiceNow directly.

Expected path: Group retire and prohibited installations by the owner group of the dependent service: Finance Apps (PostgreSQL 11, RHEL 7, Java 8), Commerce Platform (RHEL 7, Java 8 via Payments on app02), Supply Chain Ops (PostgreSQL 11, Java 8, Windows Server 2012).

A correct answer: Support Ops has none. It names the source of each fact and says plainly when the seed data is not present in the instance.
